title: Review twelve retained form and formula aliases on four chemical owners
body:
Four selected owners retain twelve identity-bearing labels whose exact form or source-correction support was not established by the inspected merge/backfill history. This is a bounded evidence gap: the native policy admits these exact labels, but policy admission alone does not establish scientific equivalence.

Review each listed literal against the original occurrence and authentic history. Preserve a damaged source label where MAPPING_SEMANTICS §3 and an exact source correction justify it; otherwise retain incompatible or unproved identity-bearing text as rejected provenance. A missing water qualifier, changed sodium/oxygen count and a source-proven spelling error require different reasoning. Do not delete all RAW_TEXT, silently normalize formulas, change owner identities, or release source holds by a blanket typo rule.

The full independent assembly covers 188 source cases and 115 proposals and remains `needs_curation`. Original peer review and evidence are immutable. Agent-authored new mapping evidence must satisfy #1226 without relabeling historical human evidence. The fix must use existing native guarded proposal validation and independent re-review; it grants no maintained-owner or export approval and requires no new gate, threshold, or synonym-selection rule.
